verdict.rationale: OpenCode supports adding external tools via MCP (local and remote servers), which is the generic mechanism developers would use to wire in Jira, Slack, or Google Drive via third-party MCP servers, and it also exposes an SDK/HTTP server for custom integrations. However, there is no evidence of any named/first-party integration or documented MCP server for Jira, Slack, or Google Drive specifically. Missing for 10: explicit first-party or documented Jira/Slack/Google Drive MCP integrations, any hands-on confirmation of these specific tools working with OpenCode.
